general_notes.text_en: Donors must be 18 to 65 years old.
Whole blood no more than once every eight weeks, and no more than five times a year.
MoH: temperature not above 37 C, pulse 50-100, blood pressure below 180/100, haemoglobin above 13 g/dL for men and 12 g/dL for women. Individual centres apply their own, sometimes stricter, limits.
Bring your original National ID, Iqama or passport. MoH pages do not state this; it is the requirement published by King Fahad Medical City and King Faisal Specialist Hospital.
Eat a light meal, drink 500 ml of water just before donating, sleep 7 to 9 hours the night before, and avoid heavy exercise that day.
Do not donate with a cold, flu or other infection; wait 6 months after a tattoo or piercing, 24 hours after a minor procedure and one month after surgery; not during pregnancy.
MoH says donors can either visit a blood donation centre or book electronically in the Sehhaty app (statement from the August 2025 national campaign).

Most opening times here come from the MoH directory of blood donation centres, whose hours column is headed 'working period for the national campaign' and gives no days of the week. Entries with hours null carry that window in hours_moh_directory.

No Wateen centre list could be loaded. The King Faisal Specialist Hospital page still promotes Wateen, but its English link points to an unrelated telecom site and the Arabic link (wateenapp.org) did not resolve on 2026-10-12. MoH now directs donors to Sehhaty.

Not included because no donor-facing source could be loaded: King Saud University Medical City (King Khalid and King Abdulaziz University Hospitals; the old blood bank page now returns 404), Prince Sultan Military Medical City (site lists a Laboratory and Blood Bank department with no content), Security Forces Hospital, King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz University Hospital, King Salman Hospital, Dallah, Kingdom Hospital, Care National. None of them appears in the MoH directory.
